answer: Every claim climbs the relic of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the yarrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short.
